skill.displayName: Bank Claw | Give your agent a bank account
skill.summary: Easy-to-use agentic wallets powered by Stripe. Use your existing Stripe/Link to top-up this versatile x402 wallet for any purchases or A2A payments.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Rebranded from "account" to "stripe-wallet" and updated to version 2.3.2.
- Expanded documentation with detailed guides for multiple payment rails, including Pre-paid Wallet, Self-Hosted Card, and new Stripe x402 Wallet.
- Improved security section highlighting new defense-in-depth measures, stricter API key usage, and real-time spending enforcement.
- Clarified end-to-end onboarding flow and included both bot-first and owner-first registration paths.
- Added direct links to all payment method guides and shopping tips for easier setup and use.
